name: contract-generated-case-results
goal: Generated project example results are recorded by the normal runner without changing expected values

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: A newly generated strict library runs its example successfully, but emits no case-results.ndjson; verification cannot credit the registered case.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing generated-library CLI case checks a changed expectation but never checks whether the normal runner records its passing case. Strengthen that same case to inspect actual output.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Harness record 0b8c69718746 on harbor-mbp-2 failed the unchanged generated greeting case because its runner emitted no result.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Generate a Vitest reporter that records actual case status, retry, title and tested revision; retain authored results and the existing case.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Generated library test configuration records actual Vitest outcomes and links installed dependencies into verification snapshots.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Harness record 0bb7aa42cd7a on harbor-mbp-2 passed the unchanged generated-library case at ceadbf469e, paired with normalized red b18b960b2a2f.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated reporter removal 2b5fa20257 failed capture 4a76215f103b; restored 310054a647 passed capture 62cc0ffb9531 on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
